title: Update README and user-facing documentation to reflect TypeScript architecture

subtasks.content: Root README.md: Replace Python 3.9+ badge with Node.js 18+ badge and remove Python from Prerequisites section
Root README.md: Rewrite Installation section — remove `pip install -e .`, keep only npm-based build steps from vscode-extension/
Root README.md: Remove 'For Developers' Python section (pip install -e ".[dev]", pytest, black, flake8, mypy) and replace with npm/task developer commands
Root README.md: Remove `ck3LanguageServer.pythonPath` from Configuration example JSON and settings table; update '⚡ Fast' description from Python to TypeScript
Root README.md: Replace project structure tree with actual TypeScript layout (vscode-extension/src/server/{core,lsp,ck3,schema,data,log,utils}/, src/test/{unit,suite}/, data/ YAML files)

Root README.md: Update Contributing section — remove Python pre-commit hook references (Black, flake8); replace pygls acknowledgment with vscode-languageserver ^9.0.1; remove pygls docs link from Resources; update Trait Validation to remove Python 3.9+ requirement
vscode-extension/README.md: Rewrite Requirements section to state embedded LSP server requires no separate installation; remove Python 3.9+ and `pip install pychivalry` references

vscode-extension/README.md: Update Extension Settings — remove `pythonPath` and `args` entries, update to match actual package.json contributes.configuration (enable, trace.server, logLevel, formatting.*, inlayHints.*, logWatcher.*)

vscode-extension/README.md: Remove Python Detection from Enhanced Error Handling section; remove 'Coming Soon' features that are already shipped (completions, diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, symbol search)

vscode-extension/README.md: Rewrite Troubleshooting — remove 'Python Not Found' and 'pychivalry Not Installed' subsections; update 'Server Won't Start' to remove Python path references; update Usage steps to remove Python prerequisites
CONTRIBUTING.md: Rewrite Prerequisites (Node.js 18+, npm, Git — no Python) and dev-environment setup (remove `pip install -e ".[dev]"`, add `cd vscode-extension && npm install`)
CONTRIBUTING.md: Update Pre-commit Hooks section — remove Python-specific hooks (Black, flake8, isort); update manual execution commands to TypeScript-only tools
CONTRIBUTING.md: Rewrite Making Changes / Code Style / Testing sections — replace `black`, `flake8`, `isort`, `pytest` commands with `npm run lint`, `npm run format`, `npm test`, `task test`

CONTRIBUTING.md: Update PR Checklist (remove pytest, mypy, Black references); update Bug Reports (Python version → Node.js version, VS Code version); update Project Structure tree to actual TypeScript layout
CONTRIBUTING.md: Update 'Areas for Contribution' checkboxes to reflect current state — mark completed items, update remaining items to reference TypeScript codebase

vscode-extension/CHANGELOG.md: Remove Python-specific entries from v0.2.0 Enhanced Error Handling (Python Detection, pychivalry module check, Python-path configure action, Install pychivalry server action)
vscode-extension/CHANGELOG.md: Update v0.1.0 Configuration Settings table — remove `pythonPath` row; remove pip-install known limitation; remove stale Roadmap section (v0.3.0, v0.4.0, v1.0.0)
Verify: Grep all four target files for banned terms (pip, pytest, pygls, pythonPath, Black, flake8, mypy, 'Python 3.9') — fix any remaining hits until zero matches
Verify: Run pre-commit hooks on all four modified files to confirm markdown/YAML validation passes
